python.build: relate-db 1.0.1 from PyPI (the abi3 wheel published from upstream v1.0.1, ef436ce), installed in a venv with the pinned frameworks.

crewai.build: relate-db 1.0.1 from PyPI, installed in a second venv with crewai, whose pins would hold the main venv's frameworks back.

js.build: @relate/relate 1.0.1 from npm, with its platform package @relate/relate-darwin-arm64 carrying librelate_ffi (both published from upstream v1.0.1, ef436ce), and the pinned frameworks beside it.

rust.build: The relate crate 1.0.1 from crates.io (packaged from upstream v1.0.1, ef436ce), a dependency of a template project carrying that commit's Cargo.lock and rust-toolchain.toml.

java.build: A copy of clients/java at upstream v1.0.1 (ef436ce) packaged with Maven 3.10.0 (relate-1.0.1.jar, with JNA 5.14.0 and Jackson databind 2.17.2 on the classpath), loading librelate_ffi built from the same commit.

go.build: clients/go from a checkout of upstream v1.0.1 (ef436ce), built with cgo against relate.h and librelate_ffi built from the same commit.

swift.build: A copy of Package.swift and clients/swift at upstream v1.0.1 (ef436ce), with an XCFramework made from librelate_ffi built from the same commit.

c.build: relate.h and librelate_ffi built from upstream v1.0.1 (ef436ce) (cargo build -p relate-ffi --release).
